description: Curriculum promotion record. Version A (322 items, partial 625-game data) is the IMMUTABLE experimental control; Version B (300 items, full 842-game data) is the production curriculum. The A/B comparison showed the diagnosis replicated (hanging piece #1 in both) while the training sample was substantially refreshed (1.9% position retention) — 'the diagnosis replicated; the training sample was substantially refreshed.'

promotion.diagnosis_conclusion: Diagnosis REPLICATED across 625->842 games (hanging piece #1, ordering unchanged). No evidence of diagnostic overfitting.
promotion.sample_conclusion: Training sample substantially refreshed (1.9% retention) — the 217 additional games replaced most teaching examples. Whether the new positions are BETTER is a separate question verified by curriculum-selection metrics, not by retention alone.

snapshot_context.note: mistakes.jsonl is a 500-entry rolling window; mistakes_queued_at_snapshot is the durable job counter.

integrity_rule: compare_curriculum.py verifies the on-disk baseline file SHA-256 against this manifest before reporting. A mismatch means the baseline was modified and the comparison is invalid. Version A must never be modified.
